arxiv-2105-01451.description: Abstract I Introduction Embedded systems are present on many applications such as in automotive, aerospace, industrial, and medical applications. These systems drive a billionaire market and they are responsible for more than 90% of the processors produced in the world [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2106-04819.title: Contextual Recommendations and Low-Regret Cutting-Plane Algorithms
arxiv-2106-04819.creator: Sreenivas Gollapudi, Guru Guruganesh, Kostas Kollias, Pasin Manurangsi, Renato Paes Leme, Jon Schneider

arxiv-2212-02563.title: A Large-Scale Analysis of Phishing Websites Hosted on Free Web Hosting Domains
arxiv-2212-02563.creator: Sayak Saha Roy, Unique Karanjit, Shirin Nilizadeh
arxiv-2212-02563.description: Abstract Abstract Free Website Building services (FWBs) provide individuals with a cost-effective and convenient way to create a website without requiring advanced technical knowledge or coding skills. However, malicious actors often abuse these services to host phishing websites. In this work, we propose FreePhish, a scalable framework to continuously identify phishing websites that are created using FWBs.

arxiv-2305-08739.title: On the angular control of rotating lasers by means of line calculus on hyperboloids
arxiv-2305-08739.creator: Rudi Penne, Ivan De Boi, Steve Vanlanduit
arxiv-2305-08739.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Rudi Penne, Ivan De Boi, Steve Vanlanduit. We propose a new paradigm for modelling and calibrating laser scanners with rotation symmetry, as is the case for Lidars or for galvanometric laser systems with one or two rotating mirrors. Instead of bothering about the intrinsic parameters of a physical model, we use the geometric properties of the device to model it as a specific configuration of lines, which can be recovered by a line-data-driven procedure.

arxiv-2310-01240.title: Discovery of long-lasting auroral-like radio emission above a sunspot
arxiv-2310-01240.creator: Sijie Yu, Bin Chen, Rohit Sharma, Timothy S. Bastian, Surajit Mondal, Dale E. Gary, Yingjie Luo, Marina Battaglia
arxiv-2310-01240.description: Abstract Auroral radio emissions in planetary magnetospheres typically feature highly polarized, intense radio bursts, usually attributed to electron cyclotron maser (ECM) emission from energetic electrons in the planetary polar region that features a converging magnetic field. Similar bursts have been observed in magnetically active low-mass stars and brown dwarfs, often prompting analogous interpretations.

arxiv-2402-19283.title: The higher fixed point theorem for foliations. Applications to rigidity and integrality August 7, 2026 Thanks: Mathematical subject classification (1991). 19L47, 19M05, 19K56. Key words: C ∗ C^{*} -algebras, K-theory, Lefschetz, foliations.
arxiv-2402-19283.creator: Moulay Tahar Benameur, James L. Heitsch
arxiv-2402-19283.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Moulay Tahar Benameur, James L. Heitsch. We give applications of the higher Lefschetz theorems for foliations of [ BH10 ] , primarily involving Haefliger cohomology. These results show that the transverse structures of foliations carry important topological and geometric information. This is in the spirit of the passage from the Atiyah-Singer index theorem for a single compact manifold to their families index theorem, involving a compact fiber bundle over a compact base.

arxiv-2512-16239.title: Bayesian Empirical Bayes: Simultaneous Inference from Probabilistic Symmetries
arxiv-2512-16239.creator: Bohan Wu, Eli N. Weinstein, David M. Blei
arxiv-2512-16239.description: Abstract Empirical Bayes (EB) improves the accuracy of simultaneous inference “by learning from the experience of others” ( 34 ) . Classical EB theory focuses on latent variables that are iid draws from a fitted prior ( 29 ) . Modern applications, however, feature complex structure, like arrays, spatial processes, or covariates.

britannica-1911-rowlands-richard.title: Rowlands, Richard (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-rowlands-richard.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-rowlands-richard.description: Article 'Rowlands, Richard' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. antiquary, whose real name was Verstegen, was the son of a cooper whose father, Theodore Roland Verstegen, a Dutch emigrant, came to England about 1500. Under the name of Rowlands, Richard went to Christ Church, Oxford, in 1565, where he studied early English history and the Anglo-Saxon language.

pmc-10612484.title: HOXC Cluster Antisense RNA 3, a Novel Long Non-Coding RNA as an Oncological Biomarker and Therapeutic Target in Human Malignancies
pmc-10612484.creator: Yunhe Xie, Jiarong Ye, Hongliang Luo
pmc-10612484.description: HOXC cluster antisense RNA 3 (HOXC-AS3) is a novel long noncoding RNA (lncRNA) that exhibits aberrant expression patterns in various cancer types. Its expression is closely related to clinicopathological features, demonstrating significant clinical relevance across multiple tumors. And HOXC-AS3 plays multifaceted roles in tumor progression, impacting cell proliferation, apoptosis, migration, invasion, epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), autophagy, senescence, tumor growth, and metastasis.

pmc-10657362.title: Lipases and carboxylesterases affect moth sex pheromone compounds involved in interspecific mate recognition
pmc-10657362.creator: Arthur de Fouchier, Elise Fruitet, Rik Lievers, Peter Kuperus, Jennifer Emerson, Fred Gould, David G. Heckel, Astrid T. Groot
pmc-10657362.description: Moth sex pheromones are a classical model for studying sexual selection. Females typically produce a species-specific pheromone blend that attracts males. Revealing the enzymes involved in the interspecific variation in blend composition is key for understanding the evolution of these sexual communication systems.

pmc-10740769.title: Simulator-Assisted Training of Abomasal Surgery—A Pilot Study Using Blended Learning and Face-to-Face Teaching
pmc-10740769.creator: Julia Muehlberg, Andrea Tipold, Maike Heppelmann, Sandra Wissing, Robert T Kinobe, Liz H Mossop, Martin A Cake
pmc-10740769.description: Simple SummaryLearning surgical skills on simulators is being integrated into the curriculum of veterinary students. While education has traditionally been face-to-face only, the combination of face-to-face and online teaching is described as blended learning. It is tested for its suitability for learning a bovine surgical technique. Two simulators were developed for the study.

pmc-11322045.title: Epigenomics coverage data extraction and aggregation in R with tidyCoverage
pmc-11322045.creator: Jacques Serizay, Romain Koszul, Peter Robinson
pmc-11322045.description: SummaryThe tidyCoverage R package provides a framework for intuitive investigation of collections of genomic tracks over genomic features, relying on the principle of tidy data manipulation. It defines two data structures, CoverageExperiment and AggregatedCoverage classes, directly extending the SummarizedExperiment fundamental class, and introduces a principled approach to exploring genome-wide data.

pmc-12470619.title: Artificial Intelligence in Nuclear Cardiology
pmc-12470619.creator: Roberto Sciagrà, Samuele Valente, Marco Dominietto, Ramdas G Pai
pmc-12470619.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming increasingly important in Medicine. The aim of this review is to summarize its use in the field of Nuclear Cardiology. Methods: First, we provide a short description of how AI works. Then we performed a review of the literature focusing on the articles in which AI is used for image interpretation for diagnostic or prognostic purposes. Results: AI has been applied according to various approaches for both diagnosis and prognosis.

pmc-12611447.title: Prognostic Significance of Actinin‐4 Protein Expression and Gene Amplification in Endometrial Carcinoma
pmc-12611447.creator: Li Xiang, Yutaka Naito, Masafumi Toyoshima, Mika Terasaki, Akihito Yamamoto, Akira Shimizu, Shunji Suzuki, Kazufumi Honda
pmc-12611447.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to investigate the clinical significance of actinin‐4 in endometrial carcinoma. Actinin‐4, an actin‐binding protein involved in cytoskeletal dynamics, has been implicated in the progression of various cancers; however, its precise role in endometrial carcinoma is not fully understood.

pmc-12662926.title: Species-specific marker development for accurate identification of three red algae (Grateloupia asiatica, Pachymeniopsis lanceolata and Polyopes affinis) based on complete organelle genomes
pmc-12662926.creator: Yong Jin Lee, Yeon Mi Kim, Cheol Min Kim, Sung-Je Choi, Cheol Seong Jang
pmc-12662926.description: Red alga species in the phylum Rhodophyta are ecologically and economically important, which are widely used as food and medicinal products because they are rich in bioactive compounds. Unfortunately, researchers often meet challenges in identifying red algal species and understanding the evolutionary relationship among them. Shooting away these limitations necessitates detailed genomic studies, including those of cellular organelles.

pmc-12729168.title: Knowledge on iron-rich food intake and responses toward nutritional health among urban poor women of reproductive age
pmc-12729168.creator: Md Nawal Sarwer, Md Riaj Uddin Reza, Faisal Mohammad Ahamed, Md Fazle Rabby, Laila Begum
pmc-12729168.description: BackgroundIron deficiency anemia (IDA) is a major public health concern for women of reproductive age, especially in impoverished countries such as Bangladesh. Its occurrence is attributed to poor dietary intake, a lack of understanding, and socioeconomic status. Addressing these concerns through education and improved nutrition is critical to successful prevention.

pmc-13136206.title: Potential of ASCOT-Carer for evaluating the quality of life of family caregivers for patients with Alzheimer’s disease in Japan
pmc-13136206.creator: Shinichi Noto, Kentaro Yamato, Keisuke Onuki, Tomohiro Kondo
pmc-13136206.description: PurposeWe explored the suitability of the Adult Social Care Outcomes Toolkit for Carers (ASCOT-Carer) against the widely used EQ-5D for evaluating the quality of life (QoL) of Japanese caregivers of patients with Alzheimer’s disease. This research aimed to expand the available preference-based measures for assessing caregiver QoL in health economic evaluations in Japan.

pmc-13348854.title: Association between social vulnerability index and cataract surgery care in medicare beneficiaries: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13348854.creator: Kelly C Nguyen, Taylor Hall, Siqi Gan, Erica Langnas, John Boscardin, Catherine Q Sun, Sei Lee, Catherine L Chen
pmc-13348854.description: BackgroundSocial vulnerability index (SVI) has been used as a surrogate measure to assess social determinants of health (SDOH) when conducting health disparities research, but the impact of SVI on the timing, receipt, and outcomes of cataract care in a nationally representative population of patients is unknown.

pmc-13393847.title: Integrin-binding sialoprotein as an extracellular matrix–associated independent prognostic biomarker in glioma
pmc-13393847.creator: Wei-wei Chen, Yu-xing Hao, Wen-qing Hong, Qi-you Yuan, Hao-dong Jin, Jin Peng, Ming Shan, Cheng-cong Li
pmc-13393847.description: BackgroundIntegrin-binding sialoprotein (IBSP) has been implicated in bone metastasis in breast, lung, and prostate cancers. However, its role in glioma remains insufficiently characterized. The aim of this study was to assess the expression profile and prognostic significance of IBSP in patients with glioma.
